prerequisites: General knowledge of strength of materials

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge and skills in the fundamentals of casting plastic deformation and welding.
Understand the fields of application for casting plastic deformation and welding in machine manufacturing and non-machine manufacturing materials and goods processing.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Main principles of casting technology – a process diagram
Main principles of deformation technology – a process diagram methods of volume and sheet deformation
Main principles of welding technology – a process diagram methods of welding through melting and pressure special welding methods
Fundamentals of other materials’ processing: plastic and metal-ceramic materials

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (includes three written issues with an oral discussion)

assessment_rules: Final assessment is worked out on the basis of the tests and exam results.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
